# `timedelta`

## `timedelta.days`

`timedelta.days(value: timedelta, /) -> int`

*attribute*

The days part.

- ``{{ x | timedelta.days }}`` with `x = datetime.timedelta(days=1, seconds=3601, microseconds=500)` → ``1``

## `timedelta.microseconds`

`timedelta.microseconds(value: timedelta, /) -> int`

*attribute*

The microseconds part, below one second.

- ``{{ x | timedelta.microseconds }}`` with `x = datetime.timedelta(days=1, seconds=3601, microseconds=500)` → ``500``

## `timedelta.seconds`

`timedelta.seconds(value: timedelta, /) -> int`

*attribute*

The seconds part, below one day.

- ``{{ x | timedelta.seconds }}`` with `x = datetime.timedelta(days=1, seconds=3601, microseconds=500)` → ``3601``

## `timedelta.total_seconds`

`timedelta.total_seconds(value: timedelta, /) -> float`

*filter*

Return the whole duration in seconds.

- ``{{ x | timedelta.total_seconds }}`` with `x = datetime.timedelta(days=1, seconds=3601, microseconds=500)` → ``90001.0005``
